owner: DelegatedCheckoutIntents over current native receipt/preview owners and commerce_support_documents
identity: Tenant/store plus original native preview and server-owned context IDs. Original context, challenge, purchase digests and deadlines cannot be replaced or renewed by retry.
duplicate_refusal: Bounded transactional uniqueness within tenant/store and configured issuer/organization for original challenge and receipt fingerprints. Cancellation, minimization and restoration preserve claims. This is not provider consumption or global replay control.
receipt_input: Only actual compact-JWS input is verified by the RCG-3 owner. Caller-provided expected claims, snapshots, keys or verified results are rejected. Exact token retries return retained local status; differing token bytes conflict.
atomicity: Actual immutable evidence carries verifier-instance and original-scope provenance in private WeakMaps. After cryptography, the existing synchronous kernel transaction rechecks original context/trust, native preview/source/proof, recovery and deadlines before and after persistence. A final inert row check catches cancellation during source callbacks. JSON/SQL copies cannot restore provenance.
expiry: Original deadlines never change. Authorized read/capture entry durably records a one-way expiry observation and advances revision once; another owner or restart cannot revive it after clock rollback. Receipt expiry uses the first integer millisecond at or after the exact nanosecond timestamp, retaining that original timestamp in evidence. This records terminal local status, not new verification.
privacy: One strict row per identity, bounded personal projection, no raw JWS, full context, session/proof token or private key. Exact original subject hashes drive export, held and normal erasure, reassignment and repeated suppression. Unheld personal fields minimize; terminal fingerprints remain. Holds revoke ordinary use while retaining required personal bytes.
recovery: Normal restart permits proof-checked retained reads only. Missing original live preview/context prevents new capture. Restore/import validates typed source/destination records, applies current independent suppression, refuses unsuppressed held personal records and revokes/minimizes all restored intent authority. Nothing resumes.
effects: Dedicated local document writes only; no operation/work/payment/order/source effect or new public route. Native proof checks may update session last_seen.
